example_status: Task 4.5 example. 'real_snapshot' is the saved output of the actual run for rca_001; 'fixture_snapshot' is FIXTURE data (toy corpus, hand-made ranking) that shows a completed snapshot and its replay; it is not a real retrieval run.

embeddings.revision_note: the provider does not expose a model revision; recorded as a reproducibility limit

rules.detector: the detector prediction label when its status is ok; otherwise omitted and recorded
rules.excluded: reference labels, expected conclusions, golden citations and review decisions have no field in the packet and cannot enter the query
rules.kpi: one line per channel with a mean record, in channel order: name, mean, minimum and maximum rounded to 4 significant digits
rules.question: the packet question, verbatim
rules.text: approved text records, verbatim, in evidence-ID order

processing.duplicates: a repeated chunk ID keeps its first rank; later copies are recorded as filtered
processing.excerpt: the whole indexed chunk text is supplied; no shortening
processing.ordering: Qdrant rank order (descending score); ranks start at 1
processing.scores: ranking values only, never diagnosis probabilities

limits: a fresh approximate search can rank differently; the snapshot preserves what was supplied

all four configurations reuse the same saved passages; because the query used the full packet, the passages can retain information from modalities that a configuration omits. Modality-specific queries are a separate experiment.

index.content: the chunk inventory above, embedded as passages
